notes.title: System Update!
notes.notes:
Hi! Gamers!
Updated the game right away.

1: System can be set.
Now you can set the volume and buttons!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35375532/0b1b279219ebd09bb6441d60aedba139e16720e3.png

2: Released the Japanese version.
The Japanese version was released because the technical problem was solved.
I think it's possible to use the language of your steam, so English users can play in English and Japanese users can play in Japanese.
See Steam help for language switching!

https://support.steampowered.com/kb_article.php?ref=8487-WSCN-4121&l=english
